title: A Graph-informed Kriging model for sample-efficient Bayesian optimization of wind farm layouts
abstract: arXiv:2610.35975v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wind farm layout optimization becomes increasingly difficult as turbine count grows, especially when high-fidelity aerodynamic models are used. Conventional Kriging-based Bayesian optimization often suffers from low sample efficiency in high-dimensional layout spaces because sparse training data provide limited domain coverage. We develop a Graph-informed Kriging framework that embeds reusable aerodynamic interaction information into the surrogate mean function. The wind farm is represented as a directed aerodynamic graph, where pairwise turbine interactions defined in a low-dimensional relative-coordinate space are assembled into a farm-scale mean. This structured mean captures the dominant variation in annual energy production (AEP), allowing the Gaussian process to model only the residual structure and uncertainty. translated_title: 一种面向风电场布局样本高效贝叶斯优化的图信息克里金模型
translated_abstract: 随着风机数量的增加，风电场布局优化变得日益困难，尤其是在使用高保真气动模型的情况下。传统的基于克里金的贝叶斯优化在高维布局空间中往往存在样本效率低的问题，这是因为稀疏的训练数据所能提供的域覆盖十分有限。我们开发了一个图信息克里金框架，将可复用的气动交互信息嵌入到代理模型的均值函数中。风电场被表示为一个有向气动图，其中在低维相对坐标空间中定义的成对风机交互被组装成风电场尺度的均值。这种结构化均值能够捕捉年发电量（AEP）的主要变化，使高斯过程只需对残差结构和不确定性进行建模。数值实验表明，图信息克里金在AEP预测精度上一致优于普通（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种图信息克里金框架，通过有向气动图将可复用的风机间气动交互信息嵌入代理模型的均值函数，从而显著提升高维风电场布局贝叶斯优化的样本效率与年发电量预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Graph-informed Kriging framework that embeds reusable aerodynamic interaction information into the surrogate mean function via a directed aerodynamic graph, significantly improving sample efficiency and AEP prediction accuracy in Bayesian optimization of high-dimensional wind farm layouts.
